When is Crypto trading paused for scheduled maintenance?

Crypto scheduled maintenance runs every other Saturday.

July 17, 2026

Crypto scheduled maintenance runs every second Saturday for one hour. Expect Crypto pricing to pause during that window.

..and every other Saturday thereafter.

What to expect during the window

Not all Crypto products pause at the same moment. Some will keep pricing on and off in a start-stop pattern across the hour, rather than halting cleanly for the full window.

To be safe, plan for pricing halts across the whole hour, not just part of it.

What this means for your trades

During the window you may not be able to open, close, or modify Crypto positions while pricing is paused. Pricing returns to normal once maintenance ends at 10:00 BST (05:00 EDT).
